entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_1
entries.note: Seen on a CJ4 with the brake set: values up to 10 leave the lever at idle and 11 or more send it to 100 % (not a usable axis). For an axis use THROTTLE1_AXIS_SET_EX1 / THROTTLE2_AXIS_SET_EX1 (-16384 = idle, 16384 = full; THROTTLE1_SET takes 0..16384): the Working Title FADEC turns the value into a lever position 0..1 ((value + 16384) / 32768) and picks the thrust mode from it: CRU from idle up to 0.776, CLB from 0.776 (axis value about 9044), TO from 0.958 (about 15008). There is no reverse. Read from the source, not moved on the aircraft.

entries.name: ENGINE_Throttle_2
entries.note: Same event as lever 1; on lever 1 values up to 10 leave the lever at idle and 11 or more send it to 100 % (not a usable axis). For an axis use THROTTLE1_AXIS_SET_EX1 / THROTTLE2_AXIS_SET_EX1 (-16384 = idle, 16384 = full; THROTTLE1_SET takes 0..16384): the Working Title FADEC turns the value into a lever position 0..1 ((value + 16384) / 32768) and picks the thrust mode from it: CRU from idle up to 0.776, CLB from 0.776 (axis value about 9044), TO from 0.958 (about 15008). There is no reverse. Read from the source, not moved on the aircraft.
